facts.text: A planet of the Toydaria system located in Hutt Space, Toydaria was a temperate world of forests and swamps, with mats of algae covering large portions of the planet's surface.

evidence.quote: A planet of the Toydaria system located in Hutt Space, Toydaria was a temperate world of forests and swamps, with mats of algae covering large portions of the planet's surface.

facts.text: The atmosphere was typically foggy, and carried a greenish hue.

evidence.quote: The atmosphere was typically foggy, and carried a greenish hue.

facts.text: Toydaria was the homeworld of the Toydarians, who created muck nests and lived in the atmosphere of muck lakes.

evidence.quote: Toydaria was the homeworld of the Toydarians, who created muck nests and lived in the atmosphere of muck lakes.

facts.text: Members of the species lived in clans, where a Toydarian clan bell could signify a noble family, and during the last decades of the Galactic Republic and Galactic Empire, Toydaria was governed by a feudal monarchy, the Toydarian kingdom, and was dominated by the Toydarian royalty.

evidence.quote: Members of the species lived in clans, where a Toydarian clan bell could signify a noble family, and during the last decades of the Galactic Republic and Galactic Empire, Toydaria was governed by a feudal monarchy, the Toydarian kingdom, and was dominated by the Toydarian royalty.

facts.text: Some Toydarian cities on the surface of Toydaria were large enough to be visible from space.

facts.text: In the last decades of the Galactic Republic, the neutral Mid Rim planet of Toydaria was governed by a monarchy.

evidence.quote: In the last decades of the Galactic Republic, the neutral Mid Rim planet of Toydaria was governed by a monarchy.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, a galactic war between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, King Katuunko of Toydaria, who was the current monarch, refused to support either factions, therefore making his planet strategically interested by the two warring governments.

facts.text: Toydaria was a large, muddy planet located in the Toydaria system of Hutt Space, and home to the mind trick-resistant Toydarians.

evidence.quote: Toydaria was a large, muddy planet located in the Toydaria system of Hutt Space, and home to the mind trick-resistant Toydarians.

facts.text: The Toydarian homeworld was covered with nutrient-rich muck-lakes, which supported clouds of bugs and mats of algae and a number of predators including dangerous grabworms.

evidence.quote: The Toydarian homeworld was covered with nutrient-rich muck-lakes, which supported clouds of bugs and mats of algae and a number of predators including dangerous grabworms.

facts.text: Monsoons and fungal diseases ravage the planet, and can often kill off growing stocks of agriculture.

evidence.quote: Monsoons and fungal diseases ravage the planet, and can often kill off growing stocks of agriculture.

facts.text: Toydaria was a vassal planet of Nal Hutta for millennia and traded with other worlds of Hutt Space.

evidence.quote: Toydaria was a vassal planet of Nal Hutta for millennia and traded with other worlds of Hutt Space.

facts.text: Only a few craft were allowed to fly in the planet's atmosphere, like Hutt caravels; traffic was only allowed to land or take off in specified areas to avoid collisions.

facts.text: To help travel around their world, Toydarians created a light-rail system that took them from city to city.

facts.text: Toydaria was neutral during the galaxy-wide Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

evidence.quote: Toydaria was neutral during the galaxy-wide Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

facts.text: Around this time, Toydaria was ruled by King Katuunko, who, despite his neutrality, entered into an agreement with the Galactic Republic to allow them to use Toydaria as a base to deliver supplies to the besieged Twi'leks of Ryloth during the Battle of Ryloth, following a visit by Senator Bail Pr...
